entries.7546cd942c6b1dca: Domestic affiliated companies carry out businesses mainly within Japan. Daikoh Bussan Co., Ltd. sells construction materials and equipment, Kajima Mechatronics Engineering Co., Ltd. supplies construction machinery, and Kajima Road Co., Ltd., Chemical Grout Co., Ltd., Clymatec Co., Ltd. and Ilia Co., Ltd., among others, undertake specialist construction works, part of which is ordered by Kajima Corporation. In addition, Kajima Lease Co., Ltd. carries out general leasing, Kajima Building Management Co., Ltd. carries out building management, Kajima Tokyo Development Co., Ltd. carries out building leasing and hotel operation, Forest Park Golf Club Co., Ltd. operates a golf course, and Atami Infrastructure Management GK operates and manages a toll road.

entries.b6be59c4c32fa558: This business covers real estate development in general carried out by Kajima Corporation itself, as well as design of architectural and structural works and engineering in general. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company sold several real estate development properties, but both net sales and gross profit decreased compared with the previous fiscal year, when large-scale projects with high profitability were sold and delivered.
entries.b7bd508e1cdce520: This business covers the receipt of orders and construction of civil engineering works among the construction business carried out by Kajima Corporation itself. Major projects completed in the fiscal year ended March 2026 include the Ohkozu Bypass New Second Ryudoko Reconstruction Works of the Hokuriku Regional Development Bureau, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and the Kagurayama Wind Power Station by Iwaki Kagurayama Fukko Energy GK. Carried-over projects include the Joyo Works of the New Shin-Meishin Expressway by West Nippon Expressway Company Limited and the temporary works at Mageshima by the Ministry of Defense.
entries.bee5dd016dee004c: Mid- to high-rise wooden buildings (Tohoku Branch Building, using pure wood fireproof laminated timber and the "Ranma Seismic Control System")
entries.ceddb4cc60be8e5f: Overseas affiliated companies carry out construction and development businesses and other businesses in North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. Kajima U.S.A. Inc. covers North America centered on the United States, Kajima Europe Ltd. covers Europe, Kajima Asia Pacific Holdings Pte. Ltd. covers Asia, and Kajima Australia Pty. Ltd. covers Oceania. In North America, Hawaiian Dredging Construction Company, The Austin Company, Batson-Cook and Flowanoy Construction Group, among others, carry out construction businesses, and the subsidiaries under Kajima Real Estate Development Inc. carry out development businesses.
